sentences.text: Larsonvenator represents a newly described genus and species of tyrannosauroid theropod.
The specimen designated NCSM 40000, which is referred to this taxon, has been estimated to weigh about 703.78 kg.
The name Larsonvenator was established by the researchers Sancarlo and Paul.
Fossils attributed to Larsonvenator come from rocks of the Maastrichtian stage of the Late Cretaceous.
Its type locality is the Hell Creek Formation in Montana, United States.
